title: EUCLID (Octatrack step-fire events)
author: irpina
description: EUCLID, the smallest step-fire mod for the Octatrack: track 1 fires 5 steps of every 16, spread as evenly as they go, whatever its own trigs say; every other track plays as stock. The same C as the Digitone's and the Digitakt's, and a template for a mod that changes what the sequencer plays: it names no firmware address (docs/ADAPTING.md, "Step-fire events"). Needs seq-events.
